Royal Colombo Golf Club, No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08 of the other part

Now Therefore, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested inme by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37of 1968 hereby appoint.
Mr. S. G. Sooriyaarachchi, No. 22/1, Sri Pemarathna Mawatha, Menikdiwela to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaiddispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.03rd May, 2019.My No.: IR/COM/01/2018/41.IR/COM/02/2018/42.

Royal Colombo Golf Club, No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08 of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether Mr. K. P. Pemasiri (Chief Cashier) and Mr. B. A. Dharmasena Jayantha (Office Aid) who had worked at the RoyalColombo Golf Club had been caused injustice by the non-payment of the Exgratia Allowance paid to some employees who hadworked at the Club and retired with more than 10 years of service in addition to the general gratuity payment and if suchinjustice had been caused to what reliefs they are entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 11th day of April, 2019.
